_: WHAT STANDS IN THE CAMP AND WHAT A HERO HOLDS, asked of Meshy. A camp prop's reference is its own CROP of the approved camp concept (`tools/3d/cache/scene-camp-1.png`, in that picture's pixels), so the 3D camp is the camp he approved; a piece of gear's is its own inventory icon, so the 3D weapon is the item the bag shows. `size` is metres along the thing's longest side as it stands in the game.

style.prop: Recreate the object in the reference image ALONE as a high-end 3D game prop for a AAA dark gothic action RPG in the style of Diablo IV. KEEP ITS DESIGN: the same shape, parts, materials and colours as the reference, with weathered surfaces and fine hand-crafted detail — NOT pixel art, NOT a cartoon. The whole object visible and centred, seen from a three-quarter view from slightly above, filling most of the frame. Plain flat mid-grey studio backdrop, soft even diffuse light, no harsh shadows, no ground shadow, no floor, no grass, nothing else in the picture. No text, no logo, no watermark.
style.gear: Recreate the item in the reference icon as a high-end 3D game prop for a AAA dark gothic action RPG in the style of Diablo IV. KEEP ITS DESIGN: the same shape, materials and colours as the icon, with weathered metal, worn leather and fine hand-crafted detail — NOT pixel art, NOT a cartoon, NOT an icon. The whole item visible, standing upright and centred, seen from the front and a little to one side, filling most of the frame's height. Plain flat mid-grey studio backdrop, soft even diffuse light, no harsh shadows, no ground shadow, nothing else in the picture — no hand, no person, no stand, no wall. No text.

props.words: A squat smelting furnace of rough stacked stone bricks with a short square chimney, a round arched firebox mouth glowing orange with coals, and firewood stacked in a recess under it.
A tall rickety wooden shelf of dark weathered planks, three shelves holding stoppered glass bottles of red and green liquid, small jars and a wooden box.
A heavy wooden workbench of thick dark planks on sturdy legs, with a small anvil, hammers, tongs and a metal vice on its top.
A black iron blacksmith's anvil standing on a thick tree stump.
A tall upright wooden weaving loom frame with warp threads strung down it and a half-woven cloth at its foot, on two splayed wooden feet.
A tanning frame of rough wooden poles lashed together, with a pale animal hide stretched and laced tight across its middle by cords.
A patched canvas A-frame tent of faded grey and green cloth patches over crossed wooden poles, its front flap open.
A cooking tripod of three wooden poles tied at the top, a black iron cauldron hanging from a chain over a small ring of stones with charred logs.
A low heavy wooden work table with a stone grinding wheel on a frame at one end, small bottles, fine tools and cut gems laid on its top.
A one-handed straight double-edged arming sword with a simple crossguard and a leather-wrapped grip.
A long double-edged dagger with a short crossguard and a leather-wrapped grip.
A one-handed flanged iron mace on a wooden haft with a leather grip.
A two-handed greatsword with a long broad blade, a wide crossguard and a long leather-wrapped grip.
A two-handed war maul: a heavy iron hammer head on a long wooden haft.
A tall gnarled wooden mage's staff with a carved head holding a crystal.
A short carved wand of dark wood with a crystal set in its tip.
A recurve longbow of dark wood with a leather-wrapped grip and a taut string.
A round wooden shield with an iron rim and an iron boss in the middle, seen from its front face.
A miner's pickaxe: an iron pick head on a wooden handle.
A harvesting sickle: a curved iron blade on a short wooden handle.
A simple wooden fishing rod with a reel near the handle and a line hanging from its tip.

_grip: A piece of gear's GRIP is where the hand closes on it, as a share of its height from the bottom: the pack step puts that point at the origin, so a hand bone holds it with no per-item offset.
